title: Folds of one curve: the superradiant phase diagram of Dicke modes with interacting matter
summary: We give a thermodynamic-limit account of Dicke models with one cavity mode coupled collectively to interacting matter. Integrating out the cavity yields an exact self-consistent functional of the magnetisation $m$, $\tilde e(m) = λm^2/2 + e_{\rm mat}(λm)$: a classical penalty on the bare-matter energy $e_{\rm mat}$ in the self-consistent field $h = λm$, with $λ= g^2/(2ω_c)$ the collective coupling.
